articles.summary: Launching nationwide Oct. 20, the new chicken sandwich features Chili's iconic Fried Mozz The Highlights Chili's is introducing the new Chicken Parm Big Crispy chicken sandwich, which starts with a base of Chili's Big Crispy chicken sandwich, then adds its viral Fried Mozzarella and marinara sauce for a big, crispy, cheesy take on Chicken Parm and a whole new way to get that perfect cheese pull. Since Chili's Big Crispy lineup was introduced in April, the grill bar's chicken sandwich orders have grown 175%.* Chicken Parm isn't from Italy — and neither are Florence, Ky.; Rome, Ga.; or Venice, Fla. — making them a fitting first stop for the new sandwich. Guests in all three cities can be the first to try the Chicken Parm Big Crispy starting Oct. 13, before it's available nationwide on Oct. 20. articles.title: Chili's® Builds on its Big Crispy® Chicken Sandwich Momentum with the New Chicken Parm Big Crispy Available First Exclusively in Florence, Rome and Venice
